definitions: Of a fruit, vegetable, seed, etc., ready for reaping or gathering; having attained perfection; mature.
Of a food, advanced to the state of fitness for use; mellow.
A fruit or vegetable which has ripened.

blocks.text: Malinka is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Wydminy, within Giżycko County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, in northern Poland.
